description: The right plot of Figure 4 illustrates the relationship between Accuracy@1 on geometry problems and tree width for rollout search for two models, GPT-4o and Claude-3.5-Sonnet. The x-axis is labeled "Num. of Child Nodes (Tree Width)" and features a linear scale ranging from 1 to 7, with tick marks at intervals of 2. The y-axis is labeled "Accuracy@1 (%)" and uses a linear scale ranging from 15 to 35, with tick marks at intervals of 5. The plot contains two solid blue lines distinguished by their markers. The line representing GPT-4o uses circular markers; it begins at a value of 26.7 at x=1, increases to 28.9 at x=3, reaches a peak of 34.4 at x=5, and then declines to end at 31.1 at x=7. The line representing Claude-3.5-Sonnet uses plus sign markers; it starts at 24.4 at x=1, rises to a peak of 27.8 at x=3, decreases back to 24.4 at x=5, and continues to decline, ending at 20.0 at x=7.
